You are working in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp; run `.venv/bin/python` (never uv). Run tests with `env -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL -u CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_TOKEN .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov <files>`. No network, no live model call. Do not git commit. NEVER print or write any credential. NO regular expressions in new code. No story vocabulary (no Kristin, truck, laptop, drawer, Michelle) in non-test code. Tests may use the shipped continuity-initiative package through the helpers in tests/test_observation_mode.py (`_state_at`) and tests/test_observation_shadow.py, plus a synthetic second story. Write the tests FIRST, run them and confirm they fail for the right reason, then implement until they pass. Do not edit any file outside YOU MAY EDIT ONLY. Run ruff check and ruff format on your files at the end. BACKGROUND. RuntimeEngine._turn_active (storygame/runtime/engine.py) loops up to TURN_NARRATION_ATTEMPTS=2 times: provider call, reveal resolve, validate_effects, a deepcopy `candidate_state` with `apply_proposal(proposal, apply_world=False)`, then narration_validator.validate; a ProposalValidationError on the first attempt triggers one retry with provider.note_rejection(code). Only AFTER the loop does it call state.apply_proposal(proposal) and then WorldCapture.after_commit(command, narration, entered_scene=...), which calls ItemFactsProvider.apply_item_facts(raw, ...) and that MUTATES state.facts (World over state.facts), provider fields and makes billed model calls: one item-facts match call via CloudflareTurnProvider._request_item_facts and Jev mapping checks through the `confirm` lambda. Observation context: ItemFactsProvider._observation_context() and storygame/runtime/observation_verifier.py (ObservationVerifier, relations_from_context, fail-closed verdicts; `report.accepted` is True only when outcome is 'ok' and every verdict is 'accept'). The verifier is already built and must not change. YOU MAY EDIT ONLY: storygame/runtime/capture.py (only WorldCapture.preview_commit and WorldCapture._moved_unrelated) and tests/test_observation_preview.py. 

CONTEXT. T8a already added WorldCapture.preview_commit (read it first, with storygame/runtime/observation_preview.py and tests/test_observation_preview.py; 15 tests pass). A review found two defects and one missing test group. 

DEFECT 1 (wrong baseline). preview_commit builds `real_world` from a deepcopy of the PRE-PROPOSAL real state and `_moved_unrelated` compares that with the candidate AFTER item facts. But the candidate state already carries the proposal's own authored effects (fact operations and world effects can move an item, for example an authored reveal giving an item to the protagonist), so those moves would be flagged as 'unrelated'. Fix: the baseline must be the CANDIDATE world immediately BEFORE apply_item_facts runs. Take it inside the try block after `provider.state = candidate_state` and before apply_item_facts, as a mapping {entity_id: parent} for every thing (use the World API the existing code uses: entity_ids(), is_a(..., 'thing'), parent()), and compare that mapping with the candidate world after application. Delete the throwaway `copy.deepcopy(original_state)` and the `real_world` construction. `_moved_unrelated` then takes (before_parents, candidate_world, context). Keep exclusions (protagonist, focus, visible things and their descendants) and keep ignoring creations and unplaced things. 
DEFECT 2. When the verifier produces no report (no relations / context is None) the code returns accepted=True even if moved_unrelated is non-empty. Fix: accepted = not moved_unrelated; when something unrelated moved, outcome 'unrelated_move' and failure 'unrelated_move'; otherwise outcome 'not_required' as today. 

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_observation_preview.py (add, do not remove existing ones; existing tests may only change if they encoded the old baseline): (a) a proposal effect already moved an unrelated item in the candidate state before the preview (move it in candidate_state's facts via the World API before calling preview_commit) while item_facts raw does not touch it: accepted stays True and moved_unrelated is empty. (b) the same, but item_facts raw then moves a DIFFERENT unrelated item: rejected, only that item named. (c) no relations case (ask never called) plus an unrelated move: accepted False, outcome 'unrelated_move'; no relations and no move: accepted True, outcome 'not_required'. (d) SYNTHETIC SECOND STORY: build a tiny synthetic package the way tests/test_observation_context.py builds its observatory/skiff packages (read how; no Kristin vocabulary anywhere) and prove with it that preview accepts at score 1.0, rejects at score 0.0, restores every provider field exactly, and flags an unrelated move. If the existing providers cannot be built over a synthetic package, build the smallest harness that can (reuse tests/test_observation_mode.py helpers if possible) and say so in your report. 

FINISH: ruff check and format; report counts; quote the new baseline code.
